# AEGIS Ω — GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Use \`WORKFLOW.md\`, \`AGENTS.md\` and \`REPO_MAP.md\` as canonical policy.
Before building, check existing skills, code, PRs and the authorized
external corpora. For substantive tasks, use
\`docs/SOURCE_REUSE_PREFLIGHT_V1.md\` and run the read-only
\`agents.source_reuse_preflight\` manifest validator. Missing connector
access, search pagination or a failed build cannot prove an asset absent.

Do not create new routing, authority or opaque learning systems when
\`agents/dendrite_workplane.py\`, Automaton-3 or UWP #753/#758 already
covers the capability. The preflight cannot authorize execution, skill
promotion, credential access, spending, production changes or merges.
Preserve exact SHA, accepted source evidence and independent tests.
